# ai-search-visibility-skills

Skills this pack ships:

- `ai-visibility-audit` - six-pillar AI visibility scoring for a site.
- `robots-ai-crawler-audit` - checks `robots-txt` and `well-known` paths for AI crawler access.
- `sitemap-discovery-audit` - sitemap and `llms-txt` discovery, including non-default filenames.
- `schema-markup-audit` - `json-ld` structured data, `x-default` and `en-nz` hreflang pairs.
- `ai-search-remediation-plan` - turns ranked findings into prioritized tickets.

Every audit is read-only. Nothing in this pack writes to the target site, opens a pull
request, or submits anything to a third-party console.
cases.guide:
# Prompt Guide

## Quick start

```
Run ai-visibility-audit against https://example.com.
```

## Giving useful context

Supply the URL, because site type drives which checks run.

## Structuring a complex request

```
# Instructions
1. Audit.
2. Plan.
```

## Good vs. less-effective prompts

Less effective: `audit me`. More effective: `Run ai-visibility-audit against https://example.com`.

Less effective: `fix it`. More effective: `Turn the P0 findings into tickets`.

## Known limitations

Hydration verification is open and unmerged in PR #104.

## Where to go deeper

SKILL.md.
